prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a bespoke editorial image for the About page of Summit Sight, an independent creative technology studio. One finished image.
Primary request: sculptural glass, brushed metal and warm golden light against deep charcoal; a quiet, striking study of visual craft and curiosity.
Scene: a seamless graphite-black backdrop and dark matte surface, with an original abstract sculptural arrangement of a thick clear optical-glass arc and a single gently folded ribbon of satin-brushed silver metal. Elegant, tangible, beautifully art-directed, no recognizable product.
Composition: panoramic landscape, approximately 12:5 aspect ratio, 2400 x 1000 composition. The glass and metal forms occupy the central half to two-thirds of the frame with generous dark breathing room on both sides. All essential forms remain coherent within the central 4:3 crop for a phone screen. An asymmetrical but balanced arrangement, close enough to appreciate material texture, no text area needed.
Lighting: a restrained warm-gold shaft of light grazing the forms from the upper left, crisp luminous glass edges, realistic refraction and a few delicate caustics on the surface, softly luminous amber reflections on the silver metal, rich yet readable shadows. Fine brushed-metal grain, subtle optical imperfections. Warm light is the accent; charcoal and neutral silver remain dominant.
Style: premium photographic material study with physically believable surfaces and reflections, sculptural editorial still life, refined and minimal, high detail with gentle depth falloff.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no people, no desk or studio interior, no packaging, no devices, no neon, no rainbow lighting, no floating objects, no clutter, no excessive bloom. This is an original abstract concept image, not a photograph of a real workspace.
